body: From the DM-173 review (orchestrator, this run): fix and pin — a host thread reused across two runs is counted in both (src/core/space/hostAttribution.ts:165 tests when the thread started, not when the sample happened; repro %TEMP%/dm173-review/adv3.ts case L: run 1 102,000 + run 2 73,000 vs 114,000 spent); change the condition to `inWindow(pass, at)` (keeps cases C and I).
